name: last30days
description: Local MCP server and agent skill that researches a topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the web from the last 30 days and ranks results by real engagement; Reddit, Hacker News, Polymarket and GitHub need no API key. Install: `.mcpb` bundle for Claude Desktop (needs python3) · [Releases](https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/releases/latest)
